summaryShort: On February 7, 2010, investigators questioned Colonel Russell Williams at Ottawa Police Service while the search for Jessica Lloyd was still active. Tire-track analysis, vehicle scrutiny, and inconsistencies in Williams's account had begun to collapse the image of a disciplined air-force commander into that of the prime suspect.
summaryLong: On February 7, 2010, investigators questioned Colonel Russell Williams at Ottawa Police Service while the search for Jessica Lloyd was still active. Tire-track analysis, vehicle scrutiny, and inconsistencies in Williams's account had begun to collapse the image of a disciplined air-force commander into that of the prime suspect. The case package focuses on the interview pressure, the forensic narrowing of the suspect vehicle, and the evidence trail that led from Jessica Lloyd's disappearance to Williams's eventual admissions and charges.

call911Transcript.text: Jessica Lloyd is missing. Her car is still outside her place and she is not answering her phone. Something is wrong.
What is the address where you are calling from?
I am at Jessica's residence area in Belleville. Please send officers right away.
When did anyone last hear from her, and do you see any sign of forced entry?
Last night. This is not like her at all. Her phone goes straight to voicemail and I do not want to go inside alone.
